records.summary_text:
Ley 4/2023, published on 28 February 2023, grants legal gender recognition on self-identification. Under Article 43 any person aged 16 or over may request rectification of the gender mention on their own registry entry before the Civil Registry, without the former requirement of a gender-dysphoria diagnosis and two years of medical treatment. The reform places the state alongside Argentina, Ireland, Portugal and Uruguay in permitting administrative self-declaration.

records.name: Netherlands

Visa and border treatment of transgender visitors is set out in the official WorldPride Amsterdam 2026 safety and travel guidance: visa requirements depend on nationality alone, with gender identity playing no part in the application, and a passport carrying a gender marker that differs from the marker assigned at birth or an 'X' marker is accepted provided it was officially issued. No additional gender documentation may be demanded at the border. The Netherlands ranks 13th on the ILGA Rainbow Map 2026.
